status_at_writing: Still no model run in v4. Found by a timing check of training labels only.
finding: In 7 of 8 outer folds the training set included the label of the quarter just before the test quarter, whose SWS round was released AFTER the forecast origin (2025-Q1 fold: two such labels). All earlier studies (MODEL-B2 81.8%, v2, v3) share this.
rule_L: A labelled quarter s may be used for training (and as an inner-validation target) for a forecast of quarter T only if SWS round s was released before T starts. Applied to outer training, inner training/validation, and all quarter-level fits.
effect_on_design: Stage A primary candidate stays N2. Descriptive comparisons are run both without L (as previously reported) and with L, so the effect of the correction is visible. P4 is re-run under L as a descriptive check.
